title: Staggered review playbook for model onboarding (eng/design/legal RSVP matrix)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: Create a repeatable, low-friction review/playbook that staggers PRD sign-offs across engineering, design, and legal for model onboarding (particularly Private/VPC and Dedicated model variants). This ticket defines the RSVP matrix, review windows, required artifacts per stakeholder, fallback decisions, and the lightweight escalation path so that acceptance criteria are deterministic and cross-team latency is bounded.
acceptance_criteria: A single one-pager (playbook) exists that captures the staggered review timeline and required artifacts for Eng/Design/Legal
Stakeholder RSVP matrix completed with primary + secondary contacts for at least 3 onboarding flows (hosted -> dedicated, dedicated -> private, private air-gapped)
Review cadence defined: maximum 3 business days per reviewer group, with automated reminders integrated into PRD doc and a gating checklist
A minimal legal checklist is embedded in PRD template (data residency, model provenance, export controls) and validated by Legal reviewer
Runbook for edge-case rework (scope change) that includes defined SLAs for re-review and decision authority
Playbook accepted by Product, Engineering, Design, and Legal (explicit sign-off recorded in PRD and in this ticket comments)
Pilot executed for 2 upcoming model onboarding PRDs and lessons captured
decisions: Adopt staggered review windows: Design (days 0-2), Eng (days 2-5), Legal (days 5-7) to reduce simultaneous blocking
Primary reviewers will have a 3-day SLA; secondary reviewer must be identified to avoid stalls
If Legal requests a substantive change (>2 sections), Product proxies a re-triage meeting within 2 business days rather than full re-review
Checklist-driven acceptance (not freeform sign-off) to reduce churn: each checklist item must include an artifact link and reviewer initials

notes: Trade-offs: Staggered windows reduce simultaneous blocking but add sequential latency; chosen to minimize rework in earlier stages (Design) before Eng/Legal invest time.
For small PRDs (minor UX copy or telemetry flags), fast-track path: 24-hour combined review with agreement from all primary reviewers.
If scope changes >20% after Eng review, playbook requires a documented change log and an expedited re-review within 4 business days.
We should pilot with one Hosted->Dedicated and one Dedicated->Private onboarding to cover common permutations.
